The Immersive family's home for Apotheosis. Master craftsmanship earns sockets, Immersive Smithing, Tanning and Jewelry work together with affixes and gems, and Apotheosis's reforging, salvaging, socketing and gem cutting become performed crafts. Apotheosis still decides what is rolled; your skill decides how well it lands.

Brew by hand. Prepare reagents in the Apothecary's Mortar, tend a living reaction in the Brewer's Kettle and catch the heart of a batch in the Alembic. The recipe decides the magic; your craftsmanship decides the quality.

Enchanting is performed, not selected. Choosing an offer at the enchanting table begins a short rune-weaving ritual: runes travel from the sigil to four binding anchors, and you bind them with taps, holds and chords. The table still decides what magic was rolled; your ritual decides how cleanly it binds. Works with any enchantment the table can roll, including modded ones, and is tunable with datapacks.

Jewelry is made, not crafted. Cut rough stones on the Lapidary Wheel, forge the frame with Immersive Smithing, set the stones by hand at the Jeweler's Bench and choose a finish. What a ring, amulet, bracelet or circlet does comes from what it is made of and how well: the gem sets the theme, the form how it shows, the metal and cut bias it, and your craftsmanship decides how strong it is. The reworked successor to Jewelcraft Reforged.
Test-only agent. Inert unless -Dimmersive_smithing.packtest.output is set. Never ship this jar.

Metal equipment is forged, not crafted. Melt metal in the Smith's Forge, shape it on the Smith's Anvil and quench it in the Smith's Trough. Your skill in two short minigames decides the durability and efficacy of what you make.

Leather is worked, not crafted. Flesh hides on the Tanner's Rack, steep them with bark in the Tanner's Vat, choose a Supple, Harness or Hardened finish as they dry, and stitch equipment at the Leatherworker's Bench. Two short minigames decide Integrity and Workmanship; the finish decides how the leather plays.
